Public development panel. No training, compilation or precomputed graph products reused by these cold processes. Existing frozen official singlecore denominator reused; 0 new singlecore calls.

missing_reasons.provenance.environment.peak_rss_bytes: Child peak RSS not instrumented; physical RAM and worker/thread counts recorded.

notes: Public development panel: case051 k2/3/4/5 plus eight graphs k4; not a 100-case mean or held-out test.
